important_notes: This is a web-researched seed dataset for ingestion and validation, not a fully verified commercial directory.
Images are represented as source-page references, not copied image files, to avoid copyright/licensing issues. Replace image_url with owned/licensed images before public display.
Ratings and review counts are included only where visible in public search/source snippets; null means not reliably available from the checked source.
Pet acceptance should be verified with each business before booking.
